FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Good to clarify before starting

How do we choose which country to enter first?

We evaluate market size, import tariff symmetry, logistics cost from your production facility, and competitor saturation.

Does this include legal entity setup?

We provide commercial market strategy. For company incorporation or formal tax filing, we collaborate with local legal specialists.

What payment terms apply?

For fixed-scope sprints like Market Assessment, fees are invoiced upon project kick-off. Phased sprints operate with milestone-based payment structures.
